Noah Green: quick: need a tight bench narrative for launch posts + one slide hero. goal = make the tradeoffs obvious. who owns numbers vs copy vs visuals?
Tara Lim: I'll take copy. headline + 2-line body + CTA. keep claims conservative (use 'up to'). include methodology link on landing.
Vikram Das: I'll run the microbench. recommend headline metric pair = 95th latency (ms) + cost per 1k tokens. chart = 2-axis mini with hosted/dedicated/private.
Elsa Moreno: design will do three variants (social, blog, deck). need CSV placeholder asap. prefer left-aligned numbers + right mini chart.
Noah Green: inbound plan? where do regs go?
Tara Lim: HubSpot form -> tag=bench-launch -> immediate confirm -> 48hr reminder -> 1hr before. hidden field: infra_interest. enterprise domains -> SDR queue.
Vikram Das: sample CSV I'll post after run. quick mock for design: ```model,mode,median_ms,95pct_ms,cost_per_1k
redwood-13b,hosted,34,118,0.82
redwood-13b,dedicated,29,92,0.59
redwood-13b,private,31,105,0.69
```
Tara Lim: draft social copy: "Shipping LLM features? See how serving choices change latency and token economics. Join our webinar for the full playbook. Register: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench :rocket:"
Elsa Moreno: good. timeline?
Noah Green: data + copy by Tue EOD, design by Wed noon, form + email by Wed EOD, rehearsal Fri.
reg-bot: Webinar created: "Benchmark Playbook: Latency & Cost" scheduled 2026-04-14 11:00 PDT. Reg page: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench
Vikram Das: methodology note I'll include on the landing page: seq=512, batch=auto, KV cache warm, quant=int8/4-bit where supported. link to repo.
Tara Lim: agree single hero takeaway: "95th latency vs $/1k". that'll speak to eng + finance.
Noah Green: perfect. reconvene once Vikram posts the CSV. keep social conservative and show methodology. :white_check_mark:
